quote_source: Cboe delayed quotes (about 15 minutes delayed); only derived values are published

method.what: Average net result to a stock holder of selling one covered call, by tenor bucket, call delta and the stock's condition score. Net = premium received (mid minus a quarter of the quoted spread, less $0.65/contract) minus intrinsic owed at expiry, as basis points of the stock price. Calls whose window contained an earnings report are excluded (earnings is a veto, not a cell).

sample.quotes: ThetaData end-of-day chains (research pull; raw quotes are not published)

conditions.low_beta: 252-day beta below tonight's median across the universe
conditions.rich_call_skew: 25-delta call IV minus ATM IV (~30-day expiry) above median
conditions.iv_above_forecast: the call's IV divided by the technical-fear-v3 21-day vol forecast, above median
conditions.near_52w_high: distance below the 52-week high smaller than median

validation.method: walk-forward: cell averages from years before Y applied to year Y, 2019-2026, earnings windows excluded
validation.note: Conditions were chosen after seeing 2016-2026 (signs held in both halves); the walk-forward check uses only prior-year cell averages. Expect roughly half the in-sample edge.
